newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 21.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on May 21. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Police clashed with supporters of the Moslem-oriented United Development Party (PPP) on Tuesday firing warning shots and teargas to disperse crowds in a number of areas in south and east Jakarta as election campagin violence in the capital escalated.

Harmoko, head of the ruling Golkar party, has called for firm action against people who have infiltrated the activities of the three authorised political parties with the aim of disturbing the election campaign.
The Central Jakarta State Court sentenced Siswanto, alias Robot Gedek, to death for the premediated murder of 12 boys who he had also sodomised.
Bank Indonesia, the central bank, has modified bank rating rules to improve the soundness of the country's 139 commercial banks.
Golkar's Jakarta chapter will proceed with local indoor campaigns on Wednesday despite violence election-related clashes in the capital on Tuesday.
A bystander is reported to have been shot dead by security forces during clashes between PPP supporters and security forces in the Warung Buncit area of south Jakarta.
